messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — Dedicated pool 'stratos-edge' GPU saturation detected for tenant 'edge-stream' (EdgeStream Inc). p95 latency > 3s, queue depth rising. Paging sierra_oncall. https://alerts/redwood/6254321000

sierra_oncall: On it, joining. Can someone confirm scope & customer impact?

cs-jordan: CS reports users hitting 503s for model 'gpt-neo-13b'. Multiple customer sessions failing; account team already notified.

 dmitri: Looking at pool dashboard — 100% util for 4+ minutes. edge-stream holds ~92% of pool (8/9 GPUs). Other tenants healthy but queued.

maya: If we can burst to shared infra, do we have budget? What's runbook say for single-tenant hogging?

ops-liz: Burst budget for this tenant: 20 GPU-minutes remaining. We can do manual burst override (needs approval). Runbook suggests first throttling non-critical routes (embeddings, async jobs).

 sierra_oncall: Agreed. Start throttling noncritical routes for edge-stream. Maya, can you apply a throttle policy now?

maya: Applying throttle: `redwoodctl route update --tenant edge-stream --route embeddings --qps 0.2`

incident-bot: Action logged — throttle applied by maya at 6254321060

 dmitri: Immediate effect: queue depth down ~30% in 60s; p95 dropped to ~1.8s. GPU still near-saturated though. We'll need burst to fully recover.

 alex_pm: Account manager verbally approves emergency burst up to 30 minutes. CS will get written confirmation after the fact.

 ops-liz: Requesting manual burst: `/ops/burst --pool stratos-edge --add 4gpus --duration 30m --reason "customer emergency - EdgeStream"` — initiating once eng confirms attach path.

 eng-ryan: I can attach ephemeral workers in us-west2 and bind to the pool. Deploying ephemeral-burst manifest now: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: ephemeral-burst
spec:
  containers:
  - name: worker
    image: inference-worker:latest
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
replicas: 4
```

incident-bot: Burst started — +4 GPUs attached to 'stratos-edge' at 6254321205. Autoscaler mode set to manual-burst.

 dmitri: Utilization now ~78%, queues draining. p95 ~0.9s and trending down. Monitoring for errors.

 cs-jordan: Customer reports improvement: calling sessions recovering. Account team to follow up re: billing & postmortem.

 sierra_oncall: :white_check_mark: Immediate issue mitigated. Leave monitoring on for 1 hour; plan to revert burst after stable 45m check. Handoff to dmitri + ops-liz for post-incident.

 ops-liz: Noted. I'll schedule rollback check at +45m and open a follow-up task. Recommend runbook update: consider auto-burst threshold when single-tenant usage >90% for 3m.

 sierra_oncall: Closing page. Please add a postmortem draft in /incidents and tag incident team.
